1. **High:** The README gate example does not work as described. [README.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/README.md:145) says `jit gate evaluate <issue> unit-tests` “executes the checker,” and [README.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/README.md:146) says `jit gate status <issue> unit-tests` shows the “latest recorded run.” In a fresh repo, `.jit/gates.toml` starts with `gates = []`; creating an issue with `--gate unit-tests` then evaluating it marks the issue gate passed manually, but `jit gate status <issue> unit-tests` reports that the gate has not been run yet. This violates REQ-01 because the shell example’s described behavior is false.
2. **Medium:** The README overstates the JSON contract. [README.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/README.md:161) says “Every command supports `--json`,” but current top-level command families such as `jit hooks`, `jit migrate`, and `jit worktree` do not accept `--json` at the family level according to their help output. Narrow the wording to output-producing commands/subcommands or add parent-level JSON support.
